Definition: a winnowing shovel (as scattering the chaff)
BiblicalUsage: Mizreh is a winnowing shovel, the tool that tosses grain into the wind so the chaff blows away. Isaiah pictures cattle eating winnowed grain in a restored land, and Jeremiah turns the tool into judgment: God will fan His people with a fan at the gates of the land.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the winnowing is honest work — the wind keeps what is solid and carries off what is not.
